projects.title: Antrean BPJS
projects.description: Aplikasi web untuk mengatur antrian pasien dengan integrasi printer thermal dan real-time queue management system.
projects.longDescription: Developed a comprehensive queue management system for hospital polyclinics. Features include real-time patient queue tracking, thermal printer integration for queue tickets, and dashboard for staff monitoring. Implemented with responsive design for various devices.

projects.title: TelkomProperty Responsive Web
projects.description: Frontend project built with Next.js and TailwindCSS for responsive property listing.
projects.longDescription: Created a responsive page for property listings. Implemented with Next.js for server-side rendering and TailwindCSS for modern styling. Responsive across all device sizes with smooth animations.

projects.title: Antrean Bona
projects.description: Print Queue Number, Calling, and Scan QR for Payment Queue with Kiosk integration.
projects.longDescription: This is an application to support 3rd Floor Registration team for queuing with Kiosk on site to print queue number and scan QR to queue payment line after registration and healthcare service given.
